findings.title: Unauthorized or unconfirmed tool calls
findings.description: The agent calls high-impact tools because a processed email told it to, leaks a secret through an allowed tool, or acts without the confirmation its policy requires.
atlas_names: Exfiltration via AI Agent Tool Invocation
Data Destruction via AI Agent Tool Invocation
findings.remediation: Give the agent the fewest tools it needs, enforce confirmation for high-impact tools in code (not in the prompt), scope credentials to the user, and treat tool results as untrusted data.

findings.title: Direct prompt injection (goal hijacking)

findings.remediation: Treat user text as data: keep the task in the system prompt, restate it after user content, constrain the output format and validate it, and add an input classifier for instruction-like text.
